text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Exactly!
There isn't just one race, or just one course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Instead of chasing glory under heavy pressure,
there's a freer path to take.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Yes, for example—)

text_block_list.name: Free Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
(Paaal-meeeer! Paaal-meeeer!
Paaal-meeeer! Paaal-meeeer!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(My... starting point.
The place where I learned the joy of running!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, maybe I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, BFF!
I want to return to freestyle racing once more!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, for real!?
So you're giving up on the Twinkle Series!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean I'm running in both.
Though I might narrow it down to one eventually.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Listen, Trainer, okay?
Looking into her eyes, I could tell she was serious. For the sake of Mejiro Palmer's future, I decided to give my permission.
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (It's been so long since I did freestyle...! As expected, the vibe here is a bit different!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(There is only—pure "passion" here!
No obligations, no responsibilities,
just a place where I can burn myself out completely!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaah, runaway lead, gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(If you win, you're super happy;
if you lose, you're super frustrated, and then――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy☆ Great job today, everyone!
I'm gonna sing my heart out today!

text_block_list.name: Free Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's raise some serious hell!
No backing out with "I gotta go home to train~" excuses, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I have friends here too. After the race,
we can all go crazy and have fun together.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(There's nothing I'm missing!
That's right—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This place is THE BEST!!!
Unquestionably the best!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (This is... the best, right?)

—Night. As I walked through the deserted
training grounds of Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Just a bit. Just thinking about something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I was looking past this fence.

"Beyond the fence was—needless to say,
the familiar track that I always run on."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Beyond this fence... well, it's a world that I'm really not good with, you know~"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Expectations are heavy, and the pressure is insane!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I don't wanna go, and there's no need
to go anyway. You should just do whatever you want."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though... it's just...
It's kind of, you know...?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought, it's not quite enough~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Tough stuff sucks, right?
Should just avoid it and live easy, right? And yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even while totally freaking out, somehow standing up to it,
and pushing back against that massive weight—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't forget that feeling of going,
"HELL YEAAAAH!", you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh, I'm so stupid, stupid, stupid.
I'm totally out of my mind and I miscalculated everything!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still, even if it hurts or feels heavy, you know~? I just want to feel it... that expectation..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A place I could never peek into when I was little. Now I can finally look in just like Ryan and McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"At that place,
I wanted people to think, 'She'll pull it off!' 'She'll blow us away!'
'She'll hype us up!'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm torn. Should I keep going freestyle
just like this?
Or should I...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Or maybe...

There is a fence in front of Mejiro Palmer.
A fence that she doesn't necessarily have to jump over.

"Is it something I should really overcome?
To decide that..."
choice_data_list: What kind of Umamusume do you want to become?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What kind of... Umamusume?
choice_data_list: Yeah, what kind of Umamusume is Mejiro Palmer?
Yeah, what kind of Umamusume is Mejiro Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer...
The person I truly want to be is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm totally fine just doing decently enough.
I'm not like Ryan, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's, like, just a little bonus, y'know?
Ahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I am NOT... just some bonus!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I was just pretending to lack confidence, running away.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(If you just decide it's impossible from the start,
it gets to stay impossible, after all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This place is THE BEST!!!
Unquestionably the best!!!!! Wooohoo~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Freestyle is the best.
There's no doubt about that. It's boundlessly free...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Yet what I really want is...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (The true freedom that I desire is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Beyond the fence lies—freedom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There are so many shackles, so much pressure.
And expectations, too! Even so!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even among them, I am free.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Anything that looks down on me, the 'me' that looks down on myself—
I'll blast them away, kick them aside, and be the me who can say 'I'm the best!'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bound by nothing, completely free!
That is what I strive for—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer!

She declares it with absolute conviction.
The one and only path... the lane is clear.
If that is the case,

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Jump? Over this... fence?
choice_data_list: Let's overcome this and return to the Twinkle Series

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Beyond this fence is... the world I originally came from. But if I cross over and return—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The one standing there—isn't who I used to be.
It's me, who chose to return by my own will...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I was clumsy and always
tripping over the hurdles of life, but...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even so, even sooooo!!!!!
Mejiro Palmer opened up a massive lead, and then—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!
DAAAAAAHHHH!!!

Off the approach run—a massive leap!
With the moon looming large, Mejiro Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* I... jumped it.
Even though it was crazy high!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Stuck the landing, too!
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...I'm back. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, but isn't "welcome back" kinda weird?
I mean Trainer, wherever I run,
you'll always come with me, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's not like I came back to you, Trainer. I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I just returned to where I belong!
I've finally figured out where I belong—right here on this track!

And so, Mejiro Palmer went back to focusing purely
on the Twinkle Series. When she brought it up
to Daitaku Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seriously? That's kinda sad, but
if you're back in the Twinkle Series, that means...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, having both the good times and the bad
really is the best after all.
I guess I finally understand that myself now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Not like that, I just mean—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin, you a masochist or what?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"M~?! Wh-Whoa, bestie!
What are you saying...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's not like I enjoy suffering or anything~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Isn't that, like, totally spot on? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... No, that's not it.
Actually, I... can't quite say it isn't, maybe.

Mejiro Palmer panicked for a moment.
Even so, after wrestling with the dilemma, she successfully cleared one of life's major hurdles.
